name: Security camera
summary: Wall-mounted CCTV camera on a bracket with a red LED and a round lens; use for surveillance and home security scenes.

params.name: x
params.note: where the bracket meets the wall (left edge); the camera points right

params.name: y
params.note: wall mount point: the bracket sits at y on the wall (the camera is not standing on the floor)

params.name: s
params.note: scale; at s = 1 the camera is about 500 px wide including the bracket

params.name: anim
params.note: pan = the camera head slowly swivels

author: krakujs
